census_source.description: Frame-by-frame census of a 36.37-second screen recording of the reference application, supplied by the operator on 2026-09-25. The live public endpoint exposes only the application shell/title to a crawler; the recording is authoritative for client-rendered controls.
census_source.claim_boundary: Supports the distinct UI/capability elements observable in the recording, including its 12 navigation modules. Does not prove hidden states or every record in the application.

evidence_status_rules.RECORDED: Element rendered or exercised in the recording.
evidence_status_rules.INFERRED_FROM_LABEL: Only a navigation label or descriptive text was observed; the workspace body was not opened.
evidence_status_rules.LIVE_VERIFIED: Behaviour verified against the live application (not used: crawler sees only the shell).
evidence_status_rules.NOT_OBSERVED: Reserved; never counted in the observed denominator.

delivery_state_rules.SCHEDULED_THIS_RUN: EXTEND/NEW in Phases 1-3 of run 1, not yet merged.
delivery_state_rules.PARTIAL_THIS_RUN: Run 1 delivers part; remainder named in notes.

live_bundle_corroboration.rule: Bundle string presence corroborates that a label ships in the live client; it never changes evidence_status and never adds a row to the observed denominator.

unrecorded_bundle_modules.interpretation: Live Ops labels present in the client bundle but not in the recorded census; not claimed as observed capabilities.

Run 1 (PR-2): one query field over entities, sources, observations and alerts from every producer the Hub holds. Per-page table filters (SearchableTable.jsx, hooks/useTableFilter.js) are unchanged.

The filter ships in TheHub search. READING means an observation whose producer declares epistemic_class MEASURED. The committed aggregate predates the Wave 2 producer declarations, so READING returns no rows until the aggregate is refreshed. OVNIS source_document rows are searched under SOURCE, and OVNIS declares its cases CURATED, so it emits no readings.
The filter ships in Phase 3 but returns NO_PRODUCER_EMITS_FINDINGS until OVNIS emits findings (Phase 4).
TIMELINE means alerts and observations not declared MEASURED, including the OVNIS case observations.
Every query word must match a word in the record, either as a whole word or as its prefix. Case and Spanish accents are folded.
The FINDING type answers NO_PRODUCER_EMITS_FINDINGS instead of returning an empty list. Findings arrive with OVNIS Phase 4.
Readings are searchable under READING once a producer declares them MEASURED. No producer publishes episode citations (Phase 4).
